status: Partial family port; none complete. Eight already-reviewed tuples upgraded from existing_unverified to in_progress.

25.0.0.movement: Untargeted straight diagonal flight; independent reflection from walls, no pursuit.
25.0.0.targeting: Bone acquires cardinal alignment with range/LOS; other bodies do not target player movement.
25.0.0.vulnerability: Ordinarily vulnerable, with source stage HP for first seven variants. Tainted shieldStrength10 adaptive scaling remains missing; no invented flat10 subtraction.
25.0.0.phases: Continuous flight, live bone/gas behavior where applicable; death produces configured variant pattern. Tainted has a persistent delayed-warning phase.
25.0.0.offspring: Drowned may produce23.1.0 on legal ground; other variants have no NPC offspring. Normal can own three819.1.0 through an existing group helper; Horny Boys producer remains missing.
25.0.0.completion: Living hostile bodies gate room clear; resolved offspring also gate it. Delayed explosions remain dangerous after clear; Sick gas dissipates. Debug clear cancels remaining effects.

adaptations.health: First seven variants use (8 + 3*(min(stage,4)+.8*clamp(stage-5,0,5)))*3.2; Tainted uses20*3.2=64. Source stages1/2,3/4,5/6,7/8 map to the two possible floors of each DW band. Inactive/tutorial/Classic use1. This mapping/scale is local, source formula/XML values are sourced.
adaptations.movement: World speed2.6 before existing1.1 hostile multiplier; 3D flight crosses interior cover and water, reflects each blocked axis, respects sealed boundaries. No player-directed steering.
adaptations.damage: Base contact10 (Tainted20), shot10, field8; existing hostile multiplier1.25 remains. Normal/Drowned/Tainted blast100 enemy and20 base player, radius3: these are local values, NOT recovered native Boom Fly damage.
adaptations.fields: Dragon range30/spacing1.25/progression.025s/duration4; fire clips at ground terrain/cover/water. Sick trail.6s/radius.7/duration2.5; eight death clouds at radius2.25 with cloud radius1.3/duration12. Existing gas contact policy is local.
adaptations.tainted: Warning .6s, line spacing2/delay.065 per step, max range100. Real flight boundaries/cliffs end the line; interior cover does not. Actual blast collision shields actors. Stationary warnings are not physical bombs.
adaptations.lifecycle: Ordinary and non-debug execution deaths produce attacks, debug execution suppresses them. Gas/fire use existing room-clear cleanup. Real delayed blasts persist after ordinary clear, pause outside active room, and have active128/pending256 caps; pending fuses start on admission. Over-cap work logs suppression.
adaptations.placement: Bands use positive authored habitats, sparse per-room caps and costs3/4; no opening-band family. Normal/Red bands1-3; Drowned Flooded1 and2; Dragon/X/Bone standard1; Sick3. Tainted remains unrouted dedicated Ascent work.
adaptations.replacement: Normal-to-Red phase0 probability949/10000; Flooded normal-or-Red-to-Drowned phase1 probability5000/10000. Phases use independent seeded slot streams, preserve original source, reserve conservative worst-case cumulative threat. Dross exclusion cannot be encoded until a distinct Dross context exists.
adaptations.presentation: Original renderer, procedural fly silhouettes, variant colors/face markers, X/cross eyes, skull/teeth, bloated gas sacs; bone projectiles elongated and green shots nonexplosive. No source art imported. Dragon cross/X is also shown on the upper shell, because the face can point away from the camera.

Phases use independent seeded slot streams, preserve original source, reserve conservative worst-case cumulative threat. Dross exclusion cannot be encoded until a distinct Dross context exists.
adaptations.presentation: Original renderer, procedural fly silhouettes, variant colors/face markers, X/cross eyes, skull/teeth, bloated gas sacs; bone projectiles elongated and green shots nonexplosive. No source art imported. Dragon cross/X is also shown on the upper shell, because the face can point away from the camera.

unknowns: Skatole slowing/contact removal and Beelzebub allied behavior (including harmless death attacks) are not implemented. Beelzebub does NOT mean invulnerability to all incoming damage; the earlier contract incorrectly said so.
Native speeds, attack/projectile timings, blast damage/radius, gas exposure timing and Drowned offspring chance are unmeasured; external values are explicitly local tuning.
Champion overlays and named item/status exceptions require further review and implementation.
All-camera readability, human/mixed-build balance and controlled rendered Linux/WASM performance acceptance remain open.
Ascent-only dedicated gameplay route remains missing. Debug visibility is not reachability.
Source shieldStrength10 requires adaptive damage scaling, still unimplemented; current unarmored body is partial.
